visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a white cream cake sculpted into the shape of a resting dog. A hand uses a wooden stick to pull a long, thick, brown paste from the dog's rear area. In the blurred background, a young man with dark hair and a blue shirt looks on with wide eyes and a shocked, open-mouthed expression. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of another young man in a white dress shirt and black tie sitting on a grey fabric sofa. He is drinking from a clear plastic water bottle containing blue liquid, looking directly at the camera with a calm expression against a plain white wall. (3) A pink and white cylindrical cake box is lifted to reveal the white dog-shaped cake on a white rotating turntable. Both men are visible, laughing and clapping while looking at the cake. (4) The man in the white shirt uses a yellow lighter to ignite a small sparkler protruding from the cake. His companion in the blue shirt leans back, laughing hysterically at the spectacle. (5) The dog cake continues to 'defecate' brown paste while the men point and double over in laughter. The shot captures their exaggerated physical reactions and joyful facial expressions in a bright indoor living room environment.
